image_brief: SpaceX launches five rockets in six days, three on the same Thursday including a crewed mission with astronauts

slides.headline: SPACEX JUST LAUNCHED 3 ROCKETS IN 13 HOURS

caption:
SpaceX launched 3 rockets in 13 hours on the same day, and one of them had real astronauts on board.

SpaceX flew 5 missions in 6 days from Sep 26 to Oct 1, including 3 on the same Thursday within 13 hours: astronauts on Crew-13, a classified military satellite on the massive Falcon Heavy, and a rideshare rocket launching commercial satellites. If you still think a rocket launch is a rare, months-long event, SpaceX just ran three of them like a bus schedule. No other company on Earth does anything close to this, and the entire world's definition of a busy launch week just changed.

SpaceX is lapping the rest of the world so fast it is starting to look like a different sport. The gap between them and every other space program is not shrinking. It is growing.
